geopolitics_summary: EU carbon market reform debate intensifies; Iran-Hormuz tensions sustain crude volatility; Russia sanctions stalled on price-cap disagreement.

themes.headline: EU loosens ETS rules, allowing industry to pollute into 2040s
themes.why_it_matters: Looser EUA scarcity regime reduces carbon compliance costs for power generators and industrial fuel-switchers, pressuring EUA forward curve and power spreads via lower abatement incentive.

themes.headline: EU Commission proposes methane rules; oil/gas warn of supply shock
themes.why_it_matters: If enforced, methane rules could reduce Russian/non-EU gas supply into Europe or raise LNG import costs; TTF upside risk if compliance capex is passed through or exports curtailed.

themes.headline: EU sanctions talks on Russian crude price cap stall; resumed next week
themes.why_it_matters: Delayed price-cap agreement raises tail risk of sudden ratchet-up in Urals crude cost; affects EU power generation fuel mix via HFO/gasoil burn margin and indirect gas substitution pressure.

themes.headline: Iran-Hormuz tensions persist; two-thirds normal tanker traffic flows
themes.why_it_matters: Continued Middle East disruption sustains elevated crude prices and geopolitical risk premium; tightens oil-gas arb, favoring gas-to-power switching and TTF upside bias.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025 on US capacity expansion
themes.why_it_matters: Rising US LNG supply boosts European import optionality and raises spot LNG-TTF convergence risk, putting downward pressure on North-West European gas prices and coal-to-gas switching margins.

watchlist: EU ETS / carbon market reform trilogue: Parliament vs. Council negotiations on stringency and phase-out timeline.
Russia crude price cap decision (end July): outcome will signal sanctions escalation or de-escalation trajectory.
Iran-Hormuz conflict: monitor for blockade escalation or diplomatic breakthrough affecting Brent-WTI and HFO burn.
UK-EU energy reset post-reshuffle: track new minister's approach to electricity interconnections and NI protocol trade.
